title: Les Forains
description: “The Traveling Players,” a ballet score about a troupe of street performers, by Sauguet, a composer born in Bordeaux in 1901. The Grand Théâtre, opened in 1780, is home to the city’s opera and ballet.

title: Le vent nous portera
description: “The Wind Will Carry Us,” the best-known song by Noir Désir, the Bordeaux band that was one of France’s biggest rock groups of the 1990s. Barbey, a concert hall and music school, is the heart of the city’s rock scene.
